description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useEventRefresh' that provides a function to refresh event data by ID and update a state setter. It imports 'useCallback' from React and 'fetchEventById' from an API client to fetch event details asynchronously with cancellation support.

methods.name: useEventRefresh(setter)
methods.description: Custom React hook that returns a function to refresh event data from API by event ID and update the provided setter function.
